test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If A is 6 times more than B, then B is what percentage less than A?
solution:
**Given:**

A is 6 times more than B.

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ A = 7B

⇒ {7B - Bover 7B}times 100

⇒ {6over 7}times 100 = 85.71 percent

**∴ The required result will be 85.71 percent.**
